title: SourceViewer
responsibility: Shows selected source text with its file selector, exact revision and explicit loading or failure states.

inputs.name: SourceViewer.state
inputs.description: The live SourceState supplies the available file paths, selected path, source text and loading/error status. Text is shown only when path is nonempty, loading is false and error is empty.

inputs.name: SourceViewer.commit
inputs.description: This is the revision associated with the archived files. A nonempty value shows a short hash with the full value in the title; an empty value hides the commit label.

inputs.name: SourceViewer.empty
inputs.default: No source files recorded at this revision.
inputs.description: This message is shown when loading has finished without an error and state.files is empty. Defaults to `No source files recorded at this revision.`
examples: No source files recorded at this revision.

inputs.name: SourceViewer.onSelect
inputs.description: The required callback receives the selected file path through the Select value binding. Available choices come from state.files when the list is nonempty.

outputs.name: SourceViewer
outputs.description: The markup shows a file selector only when files are available, a shortened commit label only when commit is nonempty, and loading, error, empty-list, or empty-file notices as applicable. When state.path is nonempty and the state is neither loading nor errored, it renders state.text without added line numbers or markup; nonempty text appears in a scrollable code pane.

errors.name: onSelect callback error
errors.description: An error thrown by the supplied onSelect callback is not caught by SourceViewer and propagates through the Select value binding.
